title: Every fixed bounded-charge sector has global large-data evolution

bounded_sector_globalization.sector: P_N=1_[-N,N](Q) with fixed finite N; Q_N is bounded by N although ran(P_N) may have infinite internal multiplicity
bounded_sector_globalization.gauge: Use the global Coulomb representative on the trivial bundle over T3, separating the spatial harmonic connection mode from the zero-mean transverse mode
bounded_sector_globalization.conserved_energy: E_mu controls electric and magnetic L2 energy, covariant matter H1 energy, matter momentum, mass, quartic defocusing potential and mu||Q_N phi||_2^2
bounded_sector_globalization.connection_control: Hodge and Poincare control the zero-mean transverse A in H1 by curl A; the harmonic mode changes at a rate bounded by the electric L2 energy and is therefore finite on every finite interval
bounded_sector_globalization.matter_control: The diamagnetic inequality controls |phi| in H1; bounded Q_N and finite-interval connection control convert D_A phi to ordinary H1 control without a charge-domain loss
bounded_sector_globalization.continuation: The three-dimensional cubic Maxwell--matter system is energy subcritical. The K1391 local solution can be restarted from every finite time with a lifespan determined by the finite low norm on that interval
bounded_sector_globalization.higher_regular_persistence: Standard differentiated semilinear energy estimates on each fixed sector propagate every smooth Sobolev and finite triangular tier once the low solution exists globally
bounded_sector_globalization.recurrent_compatibility: The proof iterates finite intervals from a conserved/coercive low energy and permits bounded recurrent coefficients; it does not require any global L1_t coefficient
bounded_sector_globalization.boundary: Every estimate may depend on N and on the finite time horizon. This theorem does not construct the completed unbounded-charge global flow or a source-owned action
